map.看跌保本点 = K − 权利金 = 100 − 5 = 95。到期标的 <95: Put breakeven = K - premium = 100 - 5 = 95. At expiry, underlying < 95 buyer profits, = 95 breakeven, > 95 loss (max loss = premium 5).
map.K=100、权利金 3：保本点=97。保险越便宜，下跌保护门槛越高（更易触发盈利: K=100, premium 3: breakeven = 97. The cheaper the insurance, the higher the downside-protection threshold (profit triggered more easily).
map.看跌期权最大盈利？: What is the maximum profit on a put option?
map.标的跌到 0 时盈利最大 = K − 权利金（理论），仍有限；最大亏损为权利金。: Maximum profit occurs when the underlying falls to 0 = K - premium (theoretical), still bounded; maximum loss is the premium.
map.和止损单区别？: How does it differ from a stop-loss order?
map.看跌期权是付费保险（锁定下行），止损单免费但有滑点与跳空风险，二者成本结构不同。: A put option is paid insurance (locks in downside); a stop-loss order is free but has slippage and gap risk; their cost structures differ.
